name: Iapapa Berry
description: A hold item that restores HP but may confuse.

gifts.note: Once a day. This girl in Sootopolis City gives you two Berries each day: a random one from Pomeg to Nomel, then either a Figy or an Iapapa Berry. She gives nothing while Groudon and Kyogre are fighting over the city, only before that and after you beat the Sootopolis Gym Leader.
